instruction.text: Ergänze im Dialog die passenden Häufigkeitsadverbien.

atoms.b: What do you ((++usually always)) eat for breakfast?
atoms.sound: What do you usually eat for breakfast?

atoms.a: Ich esse normalerweise ein belegtes Brot zum Frühstück. Und ich esse häufig Eier und Speck. Ich esse manchmal Pfannkuchen mit Ahornsirup zum Frühstück.
atoms.b: I ((++usually often)) eat a sandwich for breakfast. And I ((++often sometimes)) eat eggs and bacon. I ((++sometimes never)) eat pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
atoms.sound: I usually eat a sandwich for breakfast. And I often eat eggs and bacon. I sometimes eat pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.

atoms.a: Ich esse immer Müsli. Aber ich esse nie Brot.
atoms.b: I ((++always often)) eat cereal. But I ((++never always)) eat bread.
atoms.sound: I always eat cereal. But I never eat bread.

atoms.b: What do you ((++usually sometimes)) drink for breakfast?
atoms.sound: What do you usually drink for breakfast?

atoms.a: Ich trinke immer Wasser. Aber ich trinke nie Tee.
atoms.b: I ((++always sometimes)) drink water. But I ((++never often)) drink tea.
atoms.sound: I always drink water. But I never drink tea.

atoms.a: Ich trinke normalerweise Orangensaft zum Frühstück. Und ich trinke häufig Karottensaft. Ich trinke manchmal Kakao zum Frühstück.
atoms.b: I ((++usually always)) drink orange juice for breakfast. And I ((++often sometimes)) drink carrot juice. I ((++sometimes never)) drink cocoa for breakfast.
atoms.sound: I usually drink orange juice for breakfast. And I often drink carrot juice. I sometimes drink cocoa for breakfast.
